# sc-cdn.net
> Snapchat’s static content and documentation delivery domain, hosting developer docs, SDK references, and support resources.

This domain serves documentation and static assets for Snap’s developer ecosystem, including Camera Kit, Creative Kit, Login Kit, Marketing API, Lens Studio, and related platform guides.

## Developer Platform
- [Snap for Developers](https://developers.snap.com/): Main entry point for Snap’s developer platform, products, and documentation.
- [Documentation Home](https://developers.snap.com/docs): Central hub for Snap developer documentation across products and APIs.
- [Developer Blog](https://developers.snap.com/blog): Product updates, announcements, and technical posts for Snap developers.
- [Support](https://developers.snap.com/support): Support resources and help channels for developers building on Snap.
- [Developer Terms](https://developers.snap.com/terms): Terms and policies governing use of Snap developer products.
- [Community Guidelines](https://developers.snap.com/community-guidelines): Rules and expectations for developer and creator participation.

## Camera Kit
- [Camera Kit Overview](https://developers.snap.com/camera-kit): Overview of Camera Kit capabilities, platforms, and integration options.
- [Camera Kit Documentation](https://developers.snap.com/camera-kit/docs): Core documentation for integrating Snap’s AR camera into apps.
- [Web SDK](https://developers.snap.com/camera-kit/docs/web): Guides and reference for Camera Kit on the web.
- [iOS SDK](https://developers.snap.com/camera-kit/docs/ios): Integration guides and platform details for Camera Kit on iOS.
- [Android SDK](https://developers.snap.com/camera-kit/docs/android): Integration guides and platform details for Camera Kit on Android.
- [API Reference](https://developers.snap.com/camera-kit/reference): Reference material for Camera Kit APIs and SDK interfaces.

## Creative Kit
- [Creative Kit Overview](https://developers.snap.com/creative-kit): Overview of sharing creative content from apps into Snapchat.
- [Creative Kit Documentation](https://developers.snap.com/creative-kit/docs): Setup and implementation guides for Creative Kit integrations.
- [iOS Integration](https://developers.snap.com/creative-kit/docs/ios): iOS-specific setup and usage details for Creative Kit.
- [Android Integration](https://developers.snap.com/creative-kit/docs/android): Android-specific setup and usage details for Creative Kit.
- [Web Integration](https://developers.snap.com/creative-kit/docs/web): Web sharing integration guidance for Creative Kit.
- [Creative Kit FAQ](https://developers.snap.com/creative-kit/docs/faq): Common questions and implementation notes for Creative Kit.

## Login Kit
- [Login Kit Overview](https://developers.snap.com/login-kit): Overview of Snapchat authentication and account linking for apps.
- [Login Kit Documentation](https://developers.snap.com/login-kit/docs): Core guides for implementing Snapchat login flows.
- [Web Login](https://developers.snap.com/login-kit/docs/web): Web authentication setup and OAuth flow guidance.
- [iOS Login](https://developers.snap.com/login-kit/docs/ios): iOS integration details for Snapchat login.
- [Android Login](https://developers.snap.com/login-kit/docs/android): Android integration details for Snapchat login.
- [API Reference](https://developers.snap.com/login-kit/reference): Reference documentation for Login Kit endpoints and parameters.

## Marketing API
- [Marketing API Overview](https://developers.snap.com/marketing-api): Overview of Snap’s advertising and campaign management APIs.
- [Marketing API Documentation](https://developers.snap.com/marketing-api/docs): Guides for authentication, entities, reporting, and workflows.
- [API Reference](https://developers.snap.com/marketing-api/reference): Endpoint reference for campaigns, ads, creatives, and reporting.
- [Postman Collection](https://developers.snap.com/marketing-api/docs/postman): Postman resources for exploring Marketing API endpoints.
- [Rate Limits](https://developers.snap.com/marketing-api/docs/rate-limits): Usage limits and best practices for reliable API consumption.
- [Changelog](https://developers.snap.com/marketing-api/docs/changelog): Notable changes and updates to the Marketing API.

## Lens Studio
- [Lens Studio Overview](https://developers.snap.com/lens-studio): Overview of Lens Studio for building AR Lenses.
- [Lens Studio Documentation](https://developers.snap.com/lens-studio/docs): Authoring guides, scripting help, and publishing documentation.
- [Getting Started](https://developers.snap.com/lens-studio/docs/getting-started): Introductory guides for creating and testing Lenses.
- [Scripting](https://developers.snap.com/lens-studio/docs/scripting): Script API usage and development guidance for Lens projects.
- [Templates](https://developers.snap.com/lens-studio/docs/templates): Template-based starting points for common Lens experiences.
- [Publishing](https://developers.snap.com/lens-studio/docs/publishing): Steps and requirements for submitting and publishing Lenses.

## Lens Web Builder and AR Creation
- [Lens Web Builder](https://developers.snap.com/lens-web-builder): Browser-based tools for creating and customizing AR Lens experiences.
- [Lens Web Builder Docs](https://developers.snap.com/lens-web-builder/docs): Documentation for building Lenses with web-based Snap tools.
- [Asset Library](https://developers.snap.com/lens-web-builder/docs/assets): Guidance on using assets within web-based Lens creation workflows.
- [Publishing Guide](https://developers.snap.com/lens-web-builder/docs/publishing): Instructions for exporting and publishing web-built Lens projects.

## Snap Kit and Platform Integration
- [Snap Kit Overview](https://developers.snap.com/snap-kit): Overview of Snap Kit products for login, sharing, and camera experiences.
- [App Registration](https://developers.snap.com/docs/app-registration): Instructions for creating and configuring a Snap developer app.
- [OAuth Scopes](https://developers.snap.com/docs/oauth-scopes): Available scopes and permissions for Snap authentication flows.
- [Brand Guidelines](https://developers.snap.com/docs/brand-guidelines): Branding requirements for apps integrating Snap products.
- [Compliance](https://developers.snap.com/docs/compliance): Compliance expectations and review considerations for integrations.

## Resources
- [Status Page](https://status.snapchat.com/): Service status and incident reporting for Snapchat platform services.
- [Lens Explorer](https://lens.snapchat.com/): Public discovery site for Snapchat Lenses and AR experiences.
- [Business Help Center](https://businesshelp.snapchat.com/): Help articles for advertisers and business platform users.
- [Snap AR](https://ar.snap.com/): Snap’s AR platform site with product information and creator resources.
- [Snapchat for Business](https://forbusiness.snapchat.com/): Business platform entry point for advertising and marketing solutions.
- [Lens Studio Download](https://ar.snap.com/lens-studio): Download page and product information for Lens Studio.
